questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg kiggede meget på de enkelte universiteters fag, for at være sikker på at jeg kunne tilmelde mig kurser, som jeg syntes var interessante

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: En masse mails og en introdag for alle nye udvekslingsstuderende, hvor vi både blev introduceret til universitetet og byen.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det er nemt hvis man er villig til at betale for dyre studieboliger. Jeg var heldig at finde noget andet til en ok pris.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det gør ingenting at bo off campus

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Melbourne er en dyr by at bo i. Prøv at finde værelser hos private udlejere gennem facebooksider. Det er hårdt arbejde, men klart det værd.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Meget

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Undersøg hvornår dine fag har timer. Det er fedt hvis man kan holde en eller to dage om ugen fri så man kan bruge disse på at tage på ture osv.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Meget blandet niveau. Man kan tage breadth courses som er meget chill men måske ikke så fagligt relevante. Prøv at blande dine kurser lidt, så der både er "hyggekurser" og nogle du synes er fagligt spændende.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde flere løbende afleveringer end jeg er vant til hjemme.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Coastal Landforms and Processes
Introduction to Programming
Australian Surfing
Sustainable Development

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Australian Surfing eller et andet breadth course hvis du har nogle valgfrie kurser. Det er hyggeligt men spændende, og letter noget af arbejdsbyrden så du kan bruge din fritid på andet end skolearbejde.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Student visa til Australien er mega dyrt. Kostede over 7000 kr. Hvis man vil kan an købe et working holiday visa i stedet, men så skal man være opmærksom på at man ikke kan bruge dette i fremtiden.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er ret dyrt at købe ind i Australien. At spise ude er en smule billigere end i Danmark.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Mange forskellige klubber med ugentlige/månedlige arrangementer.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Surfklubben har tre surfcamps pr. semester. Der deltager mange andre udvekslingsstuderende og er en sjov måde at snakke med nogle nye mennekser.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Wilsons Prom, the Grampians, Great Ocean Road

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der er MANGE asiater i Melbourne (måske Australien generel). De er søde, men hvis man ikke havde forventet det kan det komme som et chok at tage et fag med 80% kinesere.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Pub-kulturen i hele Australien er hyggelig. Køb en parma og en schooner og se en footy kamp på fjernsynet.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Der er meget mere at opleve i Victoria end man lige tror. Der er ikke noget grund til at flyve hele Australien rundt for at tage på tur.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
